non_numeric_policy: No calibrated family probability, score cutoff, or Template Resemblance threshold is authorized by this validation.
selection_pipeline: load Creative Fit only; reject any Production Feasibility field
identify the first persuasive job that must be solved before CTA
generate plausible family candidates from decision-job signature + fit signals
apply explicit collision rules and prohibited/misfit rules
select one dominant family when one decision job clearly leads
attach optional secondary influence when a second logic materially shapes composition
if two families remain co-dominant after collision rules, return HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than force a winner
after family selection, pass Production Feasibility only to realization adaptation

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: make the desired sensory/experiential state imaginable before dense explanation
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: naturalness or calm styling alone is insufficient

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: reduce wrong-choice/safety anxiety with boundaries, suitability and structured reassurance
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: high trust requirement alone does not distinguish F02 from F06

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: establish aspirational/premium authority while carrying rational support into commitment
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: premium styling, large type or high price alone is insufficient

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: make maker, practitioner, material provenance or craft process indispensable to trust/meaning
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: warm human imagery without provenance/craft relevance is insufficient

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: route a customer who already accepts the category through ambiguous services/options toward the right fit
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: multiple cards/plans alone is insufficient; real self-selection ambiguity must exist

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: prove that a method/mechanism/process is credible and causally capable of producing the desired change
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: feature inventory without causal/risk framing is insufficient

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: make ongoing local/community/human relationship itself a reason to choose
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: address/geography or generic 地域密着 language alone is insufficient

family_decision_rules.primary_decision_job: help a low-readiness customer understand the category and self-place before asking for commitment
family_decision_rules.anti_rule: education content alone is insufficient if the customer already accepts the category and only needs option routing

collision_rules.resolve_by: safety/suitability reassurance leads -> F02; mechanism efficacy proof leads -> F06
category accepted + option ambiguity -> F05; category/fit understanding precedes option choice -> F08
experience imagination leads -> F01; provenance/human technique is indispensable -> F04
aspirational authority leads -> F03; maker/provenance authority leads -> F04
human craft without decision-relevant locality -> F04; ongoing local relationship changes choice -> F07
method credibility is gating question -> F06; category understanding is gating question -> F08

human_review_triggers: two families remain co-dominant after an explicit collision rule
customer category acceptance/readiness cannot be established
locality is present but its decision relevance is unclear
premium authority and provenance are inseparable and neither is subordinate
safety reassurance and mechanism proof are co-equal before CTA
case falls materially outside Beauty/Wellness and directly adjacent validation coverage
